units.source_text: 第三張照片最為古怪，完全無法估測他的年齡。

en.t: The third photograph was the strangest of all; it was completely impossible to guess his age.

units.source_text: 頭髮略顯花白，那是在髒亂不堪的房間一隅（照片清楚地拍出室內牆壁有三處剝落），他的雙手伸向小小的火盆取暖。

en.t: His hair was somewhat gray, and in a corner of a filthy room, where the photograph clearly showed three places where the interior wall had peeled away, he held both hands out toward a small brazier to warm them.

units.source_text: 這次他沒有笑，面無表情。

en.t: This time he was not smiling; his face was expressionless.

units.source_text: 他坐著，雙手伸向火盆，像自然死去了一樣，照片上瀰漫著不祥的氣氛。

en.t: He sat there with both hands held out toward the brazier, as if he had died naturally, and an ominous atmosphere hung over the photograph.

units.source_text: 奇怪的不只這些，由於照片把他的臉拍得很大，因此我得以仔細端詳那張臉的面部輪廓。

en.t: That was not the only strange thing. Because the photograph showed his face quite large, I was able to study the contours of that face carefully.

units.source_text: 無論是額頭、額頭上的皺紋，還是眉毛、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴和下頦，看起來都平常無奇。

en.t: Whether it was the forehead, the wrinkles on the forehead, or the eyebrows, eyes, nose, mouth, and chin, everything looked utterly ordinary.

units.source_text: 這張臉不只是毫無表情，更不會給人留下任何印象。

en.t: This face was not merely expressionless; it left no impression at all.
